standard_deviation_discrepancy_audit.finding: The machine-readable full_strategy_summary.json accurately records the exact sample standard deviations matching the baseline (e.g. S0 cPSNR std = 4.1478). However, the narrative markdown table in FULL_EVALUATION_REPORT.md Section 2 reported erroneous standard deviations (1.63, 1.58, 0.091, 0.046, 0.026).
standard_deviation_discrepancy_audit.root_cause: The full evaluation runner script (run_full_evaluation.py lines 343-352) printed only means to the terminal stdout and omitted standard deviations from console output. When the LLM drafted the markdown table in FULL_EVALUATION_REPORT.md, it manually interpolated/transcribed fabricated +- values instead of reading them from full_strategy_summary.json.
